scientific_integrity: All 104 carriers, their orbits and inclusion maps, the complete characteristic-zero rank bounds, and two unimodular integer generation certificates are reconstructed by the bundled standard-library verifier. The previously known wedge-of-25-spheres global homotopy type is explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the ordinary open-neighborhood complex of the thirteen-vertex Paley graph and its order-78 affine subgroup. Does not describe all relations among 104 carriers, generalize to other Paley orders, or claim global publication priority.
title: Two affine orbits of shortest Paley neighborhood spheres generate integral second homology
